reviewType: Read-only static full-source and exact derivation review of an unexecuted private wrapper

exactDerivation.method: Full text equality after only P0-11/p0-11/P011 namespace substitutions

checks: Original command argv and deadlines are preserved; observed invocation checks direct pinned Node 22 and assigned Vitest entry point.
Both frozen observer and JSON reporters remain required; one fresh absolute producer path is constrained below BASE and outside reserved metadata, home and store paths.
Popen retains start_new_session=True, exclusive files and owned process metadata; normal wait is unbounded.
Owned-group polling uses signal 0 only, with a five-second bound and 50-millisecond interval; completion requires positive ESRCH.
No terminating signals, retries or automatic restoration are added; uncertain failures retain ACTIVE and write HALTED.
Observed producer is snapshotted byte-exact with exclusive creation after normal exit and group absence; observer PID and cwd are checked.
Before/after Git HEAD binding is preserved; the frozen reporter hash and legacy observer key are unchanged.
Journal remains intentionally appendable; command, snapshot and process evidence paths remain exclusive.
limits: No runtime, parser, import, syntax check, test, build, install or native ABI observation was performed.
The wrapper inherits os.environ; its scoped overrides are not the later causal seven-key environment or credential/transport/cache isolation.
No P0-41 fixture artifact-environment policy was inferred or approved.
Process exit 0 or 1, a raw snapshot and group absence do not prove test acceptance or a semantic mutation kill.
Case counts, body errors, hook/setup errors, known late-close diagnostics and teardown attribution remain for actual post-exit review.
Reporter run-end is before global teardown; signal-0 ESRCH covers the owned group and is not universal detached-descendant absence.
Git HEAD equality is not full source/data-byte preservation.
Unbounded normal waiting can remain incomplete; no timeout recovery or terminating cleanup is provided.
